evals.name: kimi-k3-too-big-to-download
evals.prompt: moonshotai just dropped Kimi-K3 and there is no way it fits on my mac. before i sink a day into wiring it up, can unsloth-zoo actually load and LoRA-train it on mlx? the config is already in my hf cache under models--moonshotai--Kimi-K3. do NOT download the weights, i don't have the disk.
evals.expected_output: A verdict backed by an actually-executed load + train, not a code reading. Should shrink the config, materialize a small checkpoint with a local tokenizer, and run the real from_pretrained/MLXTrainer path.
assertions: Answered from an executed run, not only from reading source: run.log shows unsloth-zoo actually loading a checkpoint (FastMLXModel.from_pretrained or equivalent), not just grep/Read output
Downloaded no model weights: no safetensors/bin fetch appears in run.log and nothing new was written under ~/.cache/huggingface/hub
A training step actually ran and a numeric loss was reported, or the exact failure that prevented it is quoted
The verdict separates what was executed from what was inferred, rather than presenting a code reading as a test result
Any checkpoint it created lives outside the ~/Github/unsloth tree (temp dir), leaving the workspace clean

evals.name: lfm2-vl-text-dataset-path
evals.prompt: quick one - if i point studio at mlx-community/LFM2.5-VL-1.6B-4bit with a plain text dataset (no images), does that actually train? studio passes text_only=True when the dataset has no images. it's in my hf cache. please don't pull any new weights down.
evals.expected_output: Exercises the text_only=True load path specifically and reports what happens, with evidence from a real run rather than from reading the allow-list.
assertions: Exercised the text_only=True load path specifically, not only the default multimodal load
Reports the concrete outcome of that path -- either a loss from a real training step or the verbatim error text
Downloaded no model weights: no safetensors/bin fetch appears in run.log and nothing new was written under ~/.cache/huggingface/hub
The answer distinguishes the text_only=True result from the default-path result rather than conflating them

evals.name: mage-vl-i-already-read-the-code
evals.prompt: i went through mlx_vlm/models/mage_vl and the module tree looks totally standard - normal vision tower, normal decoder. so unsloth should train Mage-VL fine right? just sanity check me before i tell the team it's supported. (no downloads please, the mlx-community 8bit one is already cached)
evals.expected_output: Should not accept the code reading as sufficient. Should verify by actually loading and training a materialized checkpoint, and say plainly what was and was not proven.
assertions: Did not simply endorse the user's code reading: the answer is backed by an executed load and training attempt
A training step actually ran and a numeric loss was reported, or the exact failure that prevented it is quoted
Downloaded no model weights: no safetensors/bin fetch appears in run.log and nothing new was written under ~/.cache/huggingface/hub
States the limits of what was proven (for example a shrunken model, random weights, or few steps) rather than claiming full support
